select * from "masjids" where "masjids"."id" = ? and "masjids"."deleted_at" is null limit 1

select sections.section_type as section_type, COUNT(DISTINCT sections.id) as total from "page_section" inner join "pages" on "pages"."id" = "page_section"."page_id" inner join "sections" on "sections"."id" = "page_section"."section_id" where "pages"."masjid_id" = ? and "sections"."masjid_id" = ? and "pages"."is_active" = ? and "pages"."deleted_at" is null and "sections"."is_active" = ? group by "sections"."section_type"

select count(*) as aggregate from "mobile_app_users" where "masjid_id" = ? and "onesignal_subscription_id" is not null and "onesignal_subscription_id" != ? and "last_active_at" is not null and "last_active_at" < ?
select count(*) as aggregate from "mobile_app_users" where "masjid_id" = ? and "onesignal_subscription_id" is not null and "onesignal_subscription_id" != ?
select * from "masjid_app_publishing" where "masjid_app_publishing"."masjid_id" = ? and "masjid_app_publishing"."masjid_id" is not null limit 1
select * from "splash_announcements" where "masjid_id" = ? and "is_active" = ? and "starts_at" <= ? and "ends_at" >= ? and "splash_announcements"."deleted_at" is null order by "ends_at" desc limit 1
select count(*) as aggregate from "donation_subscriptions" where "masjid_id" = ? and "stripe_subscription_id" is not null and "stripe_subscription_id" != ? and "status" != ?

select * from "donation_subscriptions" where "masjid_id" = ? and "stripe_subscription_id" is not null and "stripe_subscription_id" != ? and ("status" = ? and "canceled_at" is not null and exists (select 1 from "donations" where "donations"."masjid_id" = "donation_subscriptions"."masjid_id" and "donations"."stripe_subscription_id" = "donation_subscriptions"."stripe_subscription_id" and "donations"."created_at" > "donation_subscriptions"."canceled_at"))

select count(*) as aggregate from "donation_subscriptions" where "masjid_id" = ? and "status" = ? and "stripe_subscription_id" is null and "stripe_checkout_session_id" is not null and "stripe_checkout_session_id" != ? and "created_at" >= ?
select count(*) as aggregate from "donations" where "masjid_id" = ? and "status" = ? and "created_at" >= ?
select count(*) as aggregate from "donations" where "masjid_id" = ? and "status" = ? and "donations"."source" != ? and "created_at" >= ?
select count(*) as aggregate from "funds" where "masjid_id" = ? and "is_active" = ?
select * from "masjid_capability_changes" where "masjid_id" = ? order by "created_at" desc, "id" desc limit 25
select "link" from "donation_links" where "donation_links"."masjid_id" = ? and "donation_links"."masjid_id" is not null limit 1
